title: carpinus macrostachya
intro: Carpinus macrostachya, commonly known as Korean hornbeam or Korean white beam, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to East Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine to provide health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its ability to lower cholesterol levels and prevent platelet aggregation. The plant is also known for its therapeutic actions, including acting as an antioxidant and antimicrobial agent, which can help to protect against oxidative stress and infections. The bioactive constituents of Carpinus macrostachya include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
